architecture.summary: Probe tooling only: script/spike/capacity-probe.ts and its helper modules under script/spike/capacity-probe/ probe the capacity and memory of a hosted tenant web service on Render (0.5c-512mb, then 1c-2g) with 1, 5, and 10 parallel MCP fetch and search calls, the Render metrics and events of each window, a disposable pages origin, WorkOS Staging fixtures, and a Staging OAuth resource; they reuse the SO-01c and SO-01d part two Render modules and the hosted-live test fixtures, with a dry-run mode, a reads-only preflight, and a client guard that touches only the thermus-spike-* services of the run and never the production service, also in metrics reads; knip lists the script as an entry point. Small changes in script/spike/render-tenant-lifecycle/ and script/spike/private-network-probe/ let the three probes share the step runner, the service create, and the cleanup reads, and let the create call take variables and a Docker command; the SO-01c and SO-01d part two dry-run outputs stay the same. The Slice 1 evidence record docs/implementation/self-onboarding-s1.md gains the section SO-01e: capacity and memory, and the SO-01e ticket of docs/implementation/self-onboarding-plan.md names it. No source, runtime, registry view, declaration, or deployment change.
